timing_unit: GPU milliseconds, not display FPS or input latency
aggregation: Median of independent round p50 values; probe p50 is the upper middle order statistic
prototype_order: Rotating methods and sizes; three rounds do not fully balance six method positions
paired_order: Reference and production alternate order at each identical camera frame
probe_camera: 24 measured frames per method and round along a repeating 12-frame yaw cycle, after four warm frames
desktop_camera: Application isometric camera with yaw and pitch changes; separate sequential campaigns
